additional_info.body:
Hi,
is it possible to check logs on the charger 170002562 today 22 of October at 11:34:41 a.m. (CU time) ?
A customer tried to charge, but he had a 0 recharge and when he tried to stop it, he saw that no credit card was associated with a recharge.
Thank you in advance.

Dear Filomena,
I hope that You are well.
After a deep analysis from the logs we detected that the end user has:
1) Plug and unplug the connector before trying to charge the car;
2) Connected the charger another time and the customer did not waited enough time to charge his car.
In any case the charger is working properly.
Best Regards,
Marcelo Küster
